text: Qwen4-Max lands at #6 in the Code Arena: WebDev — up 74 pts over Qwen3.8-Max. Give it a try! 🙌 @arena Arena.ai@arena Qwen4-Max by @Alibaba_Qwen has landed as #6 in the Code Arena: WebDev! With 1750 pts (preliminary), it's +74 pts over its predecessor, Qwen3.8-Max (0902) at 1676. It's also the top Chinese model in: - #6 HTML: 1748 pts - #8 Brand & Marketing: 1705 pts - #8 Reference-Based Design: 1770 pts Congrats to the @Alibaba_Qwen team on this release! 🔗 View Quoted Tweet 💬74🔄126❤️1788👀85934📊212 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
